answer: Resist fake identities with a mutual-vouching graph and decaying trust: a new account starts with no standing and must earn endorsements from established holders who stake their own reputation on it, paying a cost if the vouched account later proves fake. Standing fades unless the account keeps doing verifiable work. The graph exposes puppet farms: one operator's fakes form a tight fable of cross-vouches with no outside links, and their synchronized activity leaves a velvet trace no honest account produces. Once flagged, the whole reef of linked fakes loses standing together.
